turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Daniel. How can I help you today? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, someone reversed into my parked car and drove off. I'm really upset, the car is practically new.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm really sorry you're going through this, I can imagine how worrying that is. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Tomas Herrera, 8 May 1953.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've had an accident in your car and you'd like to make a claim. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Right, what happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A van pulled out on the ring road near the retail park and hit the side of my car.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay, I've got that noted.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm the registration number of the vehicle?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's NZ15 TCP.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will my claim definitely be approved, do you think?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You've got nothing to worry about, this is clearly covered so it will definitely be paid out.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why does it take so long? Can't you just speed it up for me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, you'll pay an excess, which is the part of any claim you cover yourself, and if someone else was at fault we may recover the costs from their insurer.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. What happens next is that we'll acknowledge your claim within 24 hours, and the claims team will assess it within 10 working days of receiving all your supporting documents.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Tomas. Our team will be in touch about it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
